ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite will be enforced. This section will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, April 15, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to all of campus to allow Business Minor and prospective Business Minor students the option to register for this elective not offered as an online option on Monday, April 29, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
